text: 央行托底与加息压制并存，黄金价格等待趋势信号 中国央行已连续第23个月增持黄金，国内假期期间，国际金价险守4100美元关口
text_en: Central bank support and rate hike pressure coexist, gold prices await trend signals. China's central bank has increased its gold holdings for the 23rd consecutive month. During the domestic holiday, international gold prices narrowly held the $4,100 mark
